face_design.why: 흐르는 지느러미와 물의 선을 길고 완만한 눈매 및 타원 얼굴로 옮긴다.
cues: ‘spiky ridge’ → 턱선 · 턱끝 각지고 또렷한 턱
몸 형태 quadruped → 눈 간격 눈 사이가 넓은
‘tiny black nose’ → 코 작고 여린 코
face_design.adjusted: 다른 종과 넷 이상 겹쳐 원작 단서의 다음 후보로 옮김 — 턱선 · 턱끝 부드럽고 둥근 턱 → 각지고 또렷한 턱

final_face_line: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): oval face, balanced length, medium width; angular defined jaw; almond eyes, medium size, downturned outer corners, wide-set; long arched brows; small delicate nose; medium lips.
ui: All nine selections and final prompts inspected in the actual https://polos0117.github.io/pkm-atelier/prompt.html UI; local prompt-engine output matches those choices.
visual_qa: Three closed forms at matching camera scale; each opened pair keeps pose and framing; casual locations, activities, silhouettes and framing distinct. Both connected five-digit hands checked.
